text: **Recommendation:** The refurbished modular span at half price is the most suitable choice for replacing the town's aging footbridge. This option offers significant cost savings while providing a durable and reliable structure. Prefabricated modular spans can be quickly assembled on-site, ensuring timely completion of the project without compromising quality. By opting for this solution, the town can enhance its infrastructure significantly at an affordable rate, improving safety and accessibility for all residents.
